topic: Could we live in a fossil-fuel-free world?
scientific_reframe: Under what combinations of renewable and other low-carbon generation, electrification, storage, transmission, demand flexibility, sustainable fuels, efficiency, and non-fossil feedstocks can a region eliminate fossil-fuel extraction and combustion while satisfying hourly reliability, energy-service, affordability, access, lifecycle-emissions, land, water, mineral, and governance constraints?
